segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.

segments.en: My name is Marco.

segments.zh: 所以有人打电话给你，你不能接电话，所以你留言，我们今天要教你这一切。

segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: In the first sentence, we are asking someone to help me set up my voicemail message.
segments.zh: 在第一句话中，我们要求有人帮助我设置语音邮件。

segments.en: So we got two key words there.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So let's break it up.
segments.zh: 所以让我们分手吧。

segments.en: The first one is a phrasal verb, to set up.
segments.zh: 第一个是短语动词，设置。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: You can set a lot of things up, but just remember that set and up, these are the two words that go together.
segments.zh: 你可以设置很多东西，但只要记住设置和设置，这是两个一起的词。

segments.en: In this case, we're setting up voicemail.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们正在设置语音信箱。

segments.en: It means to establish or to start or to put together.
segments.zh: 它意味着建立或开始或组合。

segments.en: Yeah, to install.
segments.zh: 是的，安装。

segments.en: Like for example, you get a new computer and you have to connect all the cables and you have to connect the monitor.
segments.zh: 例如，您获得了一台新计算机，您必须连接所有电缆，并且必须连接显示器。

segments.en: So you say, can you help me set up my computer?
segments.zh: 所以你说，你能帮我设置我的电脑吗？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So he always helps me set it up.
segments.zh: 所以他总是帮我设置。

segments.en: So my computer, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，我的电脑。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And what we're setting up is our voicemail message.
segments.zh: 我们正在设置的是我们的语音信箱消息。

segments.en: So what exactly is voicemail?
segments.zh: 那么语音邮件到底是什么？

segments.en: Well you know what mail is.
segments.zh: 好吧，你知道什么是邮件。

segments.en: We have email and regular mail.
segments.zh: 我们有电子邮件和普通邮件。

segments.en: Voicemail is the kind of message you receive on your phone, your cell phone or your home phone when you don't answer the phone.
segments.zh: 语音邮件是您在手机、手机或家庭电话上收到的那种消息，您不接电话。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So basically a way for people to leave you a message even though you can't answer them.
segments.zh: 因此，即使您无法回答他们，也基本上是一种让人们给您留言的方式。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is something that's, it's not text, it's actually a voice.
segments.zh: 所以这就是它，它不是文本，它实际上是一个声音。

segments.en: So that's why it's called voicemail and you have to set it up.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么它被称为语音邮件，你必须设置它。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So there's, there's no automatic voicemail message.

segments.en: You actually have to make your own or you can choose one.
segments.zh: 你实际上必须自己做，或者你可以选择一种。

segments.en: That's right.

segments.zh: 所以我们解释说我们实际上刚刚得到了这项服务，我们真的不知道我们应该说什么或如何设置我们的语音信箱。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So voicemail messages are a kind of service.
segments.zh: 所以语音邮件是一种服务。

segments.en: And now who would offer this kind of service, Marco?
segments.zh: 现在谁会提供这种服务，马可？

segments.en: Probably your telephone company.
segments.zh: 可能是你的电话公司。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a telephone company will offer many different services and these are things that you can pay extra for and they're useful.
segments.zh: 因此，一家电话公司将提供许多不同的服务，这些服务是您可以支付额外费用的，而且它们很有用。

segments.en: They can help you in some way.

segments.en: So another kind of service is three-way calling.
segments.zh: 所以另一种服务是三通呼叫。

segments.en: Right.

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we have a service or this service.

segments.en: So the company offers this service.

segments.en: And well, why are we setting up the voicemail?

segments.en: And our friend explains that we just basically doing it to let the caller know who they called.
segments.zh: 我们的朋友解释说，我们只是这样做是为了让来电者知道他们打电话给谁。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if I call a number and it says, Hey, leave a message.
segments.zh: 所以如果我拨打一个号码，它说，嘿，留言。

segments.en: I don't know who I'm leaving a message for.
segments.zh: 我不知道我要给谁留言。

segments.en: Did I dial the wrong number?
segments.zh: 我拨错号码了吗？

segments.en: What do I say?
segments.zh: 我说什么？

segments.en: Do I say my phone number?

segments.en: So this is basically instructions for what to say.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是说什么的说明。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And you become the caller.

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So whoever is making the call is called the caller.
segments.zh: 因此，任何拨打电话的人都被称为来电者。

segments.en: And this is why we are setting up our voicemail to let the caller know who we are calling.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们设置语音邮件让来电者知道我们在呼叫的原因。

segments.en: And of course we have to ask the caller for their contact information.

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now this is important because it's not just something you have with voicemail messages.
segments.zh: 现在这很重要，因为它不仅仅是您拥有语音邮件的内容。

segments.en: You have contact information for many different things.
segments.zh: 您有许多不同事物的联系信息。

segments.en: For example, your medical care, your school, you have to include contact information.
segments.zh: 例如，您的医疗保健、您的学校，您必须包含联系信息。

segments.en: Now this would be your phone number, your address and or your email.
segments.zh: 现在这将是您的电话号码、您的地址和/或您的电子邮件。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So your contact information is not only useful for in a voicemail message, but for example, in a business meeting or a business lunch, you want to get maybe someone else's contact information so you can call them later.
segments.zh: 因此，您的联系信息不仅在语音邮件中很有用，而且例如，在商务会议或商务午餐中，您可能希望获得其他人的联系信息，以便您稍后再打电话给他们。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So don't forget, it's also your name as well.
segments.zh: 所以不要忘记，它也是你的名字。

segments.en: So I forgot to mention that.
segments.zh: 所以我忘了提这一点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Contact information must have your name.

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That means the number you dialed is Catherine's phone number, right?
segments.zh: 这意味着您拨打的号码是凯瑟琳的电话号码，对吧？

segments.en: So you reached, that means that you've contacted.
segments.zh: 所以你到达了，这意味着你已经联系了。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So as you said, it's important if you ever call a bank or in, or any type of company, it will say you have reached a Wells Fargo bank or something, and it'll give you, it'll tell you what number you called because maybe you put in your finger wrong and you just called the wrong number.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，重要的是你曾经打电话给银行、银行或任何类型的公司，它会说你已经到了富国银行或其他什么东西，它会给你，它会告诉你你打了什么号码，因为你可能把手指打错了，你只是打错了号码。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or you could use the word reached in a different way.
segments.zh: 或者你可以使用不同的词。

segments.en: For example, yesterday I was very angry at Marco because I couldn't reach him by phone.
segments.zh: 例如，昨天我对马可很生气，因为我无法通过电话联系到他。

segments.en: I called and called and called and couldn't reach him.
segments.zh: 我打电话给他打电话，无法联系到他。

segments.en: And I realized then his phone is broken.
segments.zh: 然后我意识到他的手机坏了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So actually this verb to reach someone also has to do with, with, in general with calling.
segments.zh: 所以实际上这个动词到达某人也与一般的呼唤有关。

segments.en: I was trying to reach you all afternoon, but I couldn't get a hold of you.
segments.zh: 整个下午我都想联系你，但我无法抓住你。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And I was so frustrated.
segments.zh: 我很沮丧。

segments.en: Well, actually, if I had voicemail, I would continue by saying, I am unable to answer your call right now because maybe my phone is off.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，如果我有语音邮件，我会继续说，我现在无法接听您的电话，因为我的手机可能已关闭。

segments.en: Maybe I am busy.
segments.zh: 也许我很忙。

segments.en: So we say, I am unable to answer your call right now.
segments.zh: 所以我们说，我现在无法接听你的电话。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now this seems really long.
segments.zh: 现在这似乎真的很长。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: It's a little bit strange, but this is basically the standard for how to record a message.
segments.zh: 这有点奇怪，但这基本上是如何记录消息的标准。

segments.en: I'm unable to answer your call right now.
segments.zh: 我现在无法接听您的电话。

segments.en: So you answer the phone, right?
segments.zh: 所以你接电话，对吧？

segments.en: Or you answer a phone call.
segments.zh: 或者你接电话。

segments.en: But in this case, I'm unable to, that means I can't talk to you for whatever reason.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，我无法与您交谈，这意味着无论出于何种原因，我都无法与您交谈。

segments.en: I'm out of the house.
segments.zh: 我出门了。

segments.en: I'm busy.
segments.zh: 我很忙。

segments.en: So I'm unable to answer your call right now.
segments.zh: 所以我现在无法接听你的电话。

segments.en: Just remember that that means I can't talk to you right now.
segments.zh: 请记住，这意味着我现在不能和你说话。

segments.en: I can't be on the phone.
segments.zh: 我不能在电话里。

segments.en: And actually this word unable sounds a lot more polite and a lot more formal than saying I can't.
segments.zh: 实际上，这个词听起来不能比说我不能更有礼貌和正式得多。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And that's why we use it on messages like this because it is so polite and so nice.
segments.zh: 这就是我们在这样的消息上使用它的原因，因为它是如此有礼貌和美好。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们为 Fluency Builder 所拥有的所有时间。

segments.en: Let's take a listen to our dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次听听我们的对话。

segments.en: Can you help me set up my voicemail message?
segments.zh: 你能帮我设置语音信箱的问候语吗？

segments.en: I just got this service.
segments.zh: 我刚得到这项服务。

segments.en: And I'm not really sure what I'm supposed to say.
segments.zh: 而且我不太确定我应该说什么。

segments.en: Sure.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: You just basically got to let the caller know who they called and ask them for their contact information so you can call them back.
segments.zh: 主要就是告诉来电者这是谁的电话，再请对方留下联系方式，方便你回电。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I can say, this is Abby's voicemail.
segments.zh: 那我可以说：“这里是艾比的语音信箱。”

segments.en: I will call you later.
segments.zh: 我稍后会回电话。

segments.en: So leave me your name and number.
segments.zh: 请留下姓名和电话号码。

segments.en: That's more or less the idea.
segments.zh: 这或多或少是这个想法。

segments.en: But try something that sounds more friendly.
segments.zh: 但尝试一些听起来更友好的东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So how about this?
segments.zh: 那这样说怎么样？

segments.en: This is Abby and I'm really happy you called.
segments.zh: 我是艾比，很高兴接到你的电话！

segments.en: I promise I will give you a ring as soon as I can.
segments.zh: 我保证一有空就给你回电话。

segments.en: So please leave me your name and number.
segments.zh: 请留下你的姓名和电话号码。

segments.en: Talk to you soon.
segments.zh: 回头聊！

segments.en: A little too friendly, Abby.
segments.zh: 艾比，这也太热情了。

segments.en: Just say this.
segments.zh: 照我这样说。

segments.en: Hi, you've reached Abby.
segments.zh: 您好，这里是艾比的语音信箱。

segments.en: I'm unable to answer your call right now.
segments.zh: 我现在无法接听您的电话。

segments.en: But if you leave me your name and phone number, I will get back to you as soon as possible.
segments.zh: 但如果你把你的名字和电话号码留给我，我会尽快回复你。

segments.en: Thanks.
segments.zh: 谢谢。

segments.en: That's perfect.
segments.zh: 这样就好。

segments.en: Can you say that again and record it for me?
segments.zh: 你能再说一遍，帮我录下来吗？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So talking about voicemail, I think in the United States, this is a very, very popular and almost necessary service.
segments.zh: 所以说到语音信箱，我认为在美国，这是一项非常非常流行且几乎必要的服务。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in America, if you buy a phone plan, which most people have, that means that you can use your phone in a certain way.
segments.zh: 所以在美国，如果你购买了大多数人都有的电话计划，这意味着你可以以某种方式使用你的手机。

segments.en: Like every day you have free nights or you have a thousand minutes per month to talk.
segments.zh: 就像每天你有免费的夜晚，或者你每个月有一千分钟的谈话。

segments.en: But you sometimes also get these services or you pay extra for them.
segments.zh: 但您有时也会获得这些服务，或者您为它们支付额外费用。

segments.en: And voicemail is very important because people don't text as much in America as they do in other countries.
segments.zh: 语音邮件非常重要，因为人们在美国的发短信不像其他国家那样多。

segments.en: So I know in other places, sometimes you text a message to someone and they receive it and okay, it's a message.
segments.zh: 所以我知道在其他地方，有时你给某人发短信，他们会收到它，好吧，这是一条消息。

segments.en: But if you don't do that, you actually have to record a message.
segments.zh: 但如果你不这样做，你实际上必须记录一条消息。

segments.en: Like when I call my parents, they never answer the phone.
segments.zh: 就像我打电话给父母一样，他们从不接电话。

segments.en: So I always have to leave a voicemail message.
segments.zh: 所以我总是要留下语音邮件。

segments.en: So I say, hi, it's Catherine.
segments.zh: 所以我说，嗨，这是凯瑟琳。

segments.en: It's Saturday.
segments.zh: 今天是星期六。

segments.en: Where are you?
segments.zh: 你在哪儿？

segments.en: Call me.
segments.zh: 打电话给我。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's that kind of, I think, cultural behavior that we just expect to leave messages for people in America.
segments.zh: 我认为，这就是我们希望为美国人留下信息的文化行为。

segments.en: And it's actually interesting because I've been to other countries where they also have voicemail messages and the service, but people are not as willing to actually leave the message.
segments.zh: 这实际上很有趣，因为我去过其他国家，他们也有语音邮件和服务，但人们并不愿意真正留下信息。

segments.en: So it happened to me.
segments.zh: 所以它发生在我身上。

segments.en: For example, I call someone, I get their voicemail and I don't leave a message.
segments.zh: 例如，我打电话给某人，我收到他们的语音信箱，我不留言。

segments.en: I just hang up.
segments.zh: 我只是挂了。

segments.en: And then they have...
segments.zh: 然后他们有...

segments.en: You're bored or you're uncomfortable?
segments.zh: 你很无聊还是你不舒服？

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: Because, you know, if you have a mobile phone, it'll show up anyways that you have a missed call from this person.
segments.zh: 因为，你知道，如果你有一部手机，无论如何它都会显示你有这个人的未接来电。

segments.en: So then I really just, I don't really leave the message anymore.
segments.zh: 所以我真的只是，我不再真正留言了。

segments.en: It's like, okay, you saw that I called you.
segments.zh: 就像，好吧，你看到我给你打电话了。

segments.en: Either I'll just call you back later or you'll call me back when you see the missed call.
segments.zh: 要么我稍后再给您回电，要么您在看到未接来电时给我回电话。

segments.en: But yeah, for homes, obviously it's different.
segments.zh: 但是，是的，对于家庭来说，显然它是不同的。

segments.en: You need to leave a message if you call someone.
segments.zh: 如果您打电话给某人，您需要留言。

segments.en: Although sometimes it can be a bad thing.
segments.zh: 虽然有时这可能是一件坏事。

segments.en: I definitely have a friend who loves to leave long messages.
segments.zh: 我肯定有一个喜欢留言的朋友。

segments.en: Oh, really?
segments.zh: 哦，真的吗？

segments.en: Hey, Catherine, it's me.
segments.zh: 嘿，凯瑟琳，是我。

segments.en: So it's like Saturday at four o'clock and I was just thinking about calling and I was going to come over but I decided not to come over.
segments.zh: 所以就像周六四点钟一样，我只是想打电话，我打算过来，但我决定不来。

segments.en: But then I was thinking maybe I'll just call you instead and I can see that you're not home, but maybe you're out to dinner.
segments.zh: 但后来我在想也许我会打电话给你，我可以看到你不在家，但也许你要出去吃饭了。

segments.en: I remember you saying...
segments.zh: 我记得你说...

segments.en: And they just go on and on and on.
segments.zh: 他们只是不断地继续。

segments.en: You actually, there is an end.
segments.zh: 其实，你有一个结局。

segments.en: They'll go beep and then it cuts you off.
segments.zh: 他们会发出哔哔声，然后它会切断你的声音。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I think it's like 30 seconds or something like this.
segments.zh: 我想这就像 30 秒或类似的东西。

segments.en: So it's very interesting, this whole voicemail thing, especially in the business world as well.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣，整个语音邮件的事情，尤其是在商业世界中也是如此。

segments.en: Many times people go into a meeting, turn off their phones or put it on silent.
segments.zh: 很多时候，人们去开会，关掉手机或让它安静下来。

segments.en: And if you want to reach them or you want to leave a message, you've got to do the voicemail.
segments.zh: 如果你想联系他们或者你想留言，你必须做语音信箱。

segments.en: Yeah, calls will go right to voicemail so that you don't interrupt the meeting.
segments.zh: 是的，通话将直接发送到语音信箱，这样您就不会中断会议。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for today.
segments.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里。

segments.zh: 来 EnglishPod.com 吧。

segments.zh: 您可以在那里找到我们，Englishpod.com。

segments.zh: 见。

segments.zh: 拜拜。

segments.zh: 祝你今天愉快。
